entries.33323f17600179cb: As customers' development items move from the research and development stage to the mass production stage, the company is pushing forward its 'Stage-Up Growth' model, which continues transactions by providing solutions suited to each stage, and plans to further expand its mass production stage business. entries.86de67af4ff05566: Through the division of labor with product development companies, customers can concentrate their management resources on research into function evaluation, and the company states that by also reporting the results of its compound synthesis research, it creates added value that cannot be obtained from simple contract synthesis. A distinctive feature is that the company has facilities that cover everything from the research stage to the mass production stage, enabling it to provide solutions at all stages.
entries.883570c4f260ceed: The company has research and manufacturing bases in Kobe, Ichikawa and Izumo, and the Izumo Plant has a history of gradually adding equipment for purification and grinding of active pharmaceutical ingredients and for peptide and nucleic acid active pharmaceutical ingredients, from which a structure can be read that connects small-scale synthesis at the development stage through to mass production with in-house equipment.
